snippet.title: Stranded Astronauts Saved After 9 Months…😱🚀
snippet.description:
NASA astronauts Barry “Butch” Wilmore and Sunita Williams launched for a short 2 week long test flight. Instead, fuel leaks and thruster failures left them stranded on the ISS for nine months. They survived on station life support. When Starliner was deemed unsafe, NASA turned to SpaceX’s Crew-9 Dragon for rescue. On March 18, 2025, they finally splashed down off Florida’s coast, wrapping up an unexpected ordeal and contributing over 150 experiments to future spaceflight.
